name: List Modules (SA)
help: Lists loaded modules; Linux and macOS support only the current process.
long_help: On Windows, enumerates loaded DLLs for the requested process and displays paths and available version information. On Linux and macOS, PID 0 or the current PID lists current-process module paths using /proc/self/maps or dyld; any other PID is rejected, and Windows version metadata is not available.

arguments.name: pid
arguments.desc: Process ID to inspect. Default: current process (0 or empty)
